description: This is a FastAPI backend implementation for a resume screening and ranking service. It provides endpoints for uploading resumes, creating and listing criteria, ranking resumes against criteria, and listing ranked candidates. It interacts with a Postgres database to store resumes, criteria, and ranking results. The code includes functions for parsing resume text, calculating scores based on criteria, and normalizing JSON data from the database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _normalize_db_json(value: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes JSON/JSONB data fetched from the database, handling different data types and parsing strings.

methods.name: ResumeOut _resume_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a ResumeOut object.

methods.name: CriteriaOut _criteria_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a CriteriaOut object.

methods.name: RankingOut _ranking_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a RankingOut object.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _compute_score(criteria: Dict[str, Any], resume_extracted: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Computes a simple heuristic score for a resume based on criteria JSON and extracted resume data.
